text:
A 5.0Ω resistor is connected in series with a 10Ω resistor.
There is a constant current in the 5.0Ω resistor.
Which statement about the two resistors is correct?
The current is greater in the 5.0Ω resistor.
A
The current is greater in the 10Ω resistor.
B
The potential difference (p.d.) is greater across the 5.0Ω resistor.
C
The potential difference (p.d.) is greater across the 10Ω resistor.
D

options.label: A
options.text: The current is greater in the 5.0Ω resistor.

options.label: B
options.text: The current is greater in the 10Ω resistor.

options.label: C
options.text: The potential difference (p.d.) is greater across the 5.0Ω resistor.

options.label: D
options.text: The potential difference (p.d.) is greater across the 10Ω resistor.

subject: Physics
